description:
Condition:
This vintage tobacco pipe shows significant signs of previous use and age. The bowl contains remaining residue and carbon buildup. The stem exhibits heavy oxidation and discoloration common with vulcanite materials. The gold-toned metal band shows noticeable tarnish and wear to the finish. Please review photos for a detailed view of the surface condition.
This vintage LHS Sterncrest tobacco pipe is a classic example of mid-century smoking craftsmanship. Crafted from imported briar, it features a deeply rusticated, textured finish on the bowl that provides a comfortable grip and a rugged aesthetic. The shank is clearly stamped with the LHS Sterncrest diamond logo and "Imported Briar" hallmarks. A decorative gold-toned band connects the shank to a curved bent stem. This piece serves as a characteristic collectible for pipe enthusiasts or a restoration project for a vintage smoking collection.

We ship exclusively FedEx and cannot ship to a P.O. Box or APO/FPO/DPO addresses.
We know you are eager to receive your item once it has been paid for; however, we hope you understand that everyone wants their purchase quickly. To be fair, we only ship in the order payment was received. If you want items to ship together, they must be combined at checkout.
Items must be similar in size and shape and the combined weight must be less than 20 pounds. If we feel items cannot be safely shipped together, we will not allow combining.
2) Once paid for, items cannot be combined.
3) Worried about porch thieves? FedEx has thousands of retail locations, including many Walgreens, to which packages can be delivered.
We strongly recommend this; if the package is lost or stolen and FedEx denies the claim, no refund can be given.
You can search on FedEx.com for a location near you and use that for your Ship To address (before making payment) or contact us with the address immediately after making payment. You will need to have a photo ID to pick it up at the location you selected and must pick up within 5 days of its arrival. A package not picked up will be returned to us; when we receive it, we will post a refund of the purchase price and relist it.
For security purposes, we will only change an address to a secure FedEx pick up location address after payment has been made. No other address change will be made once payment has processed.
4) Items will not be dismantled for any reason; no exceptions.
5) Shipping charges cannot be added to a paid order.
FedEx includes insurance for the order purchase price and shipping cost up to $100.
All orders over $100 will be shipped requiring a signature,
unless being shipped to a designated FedEx pick-up location.
If you would like to add signature requested delivery or additional insurance, just click
Contact Seller
near the top of the item's auction page prior to making payment.

description:
Scotch EG T-120 VHS Tape Lot - 49 Tapes
Blank Media - VHS Format
Late 1980s/Early 1990s Era
This massive lot features 49 original Scotch EG T-120 videocassettes, a staple of the home recording era produced by 3M. Known for their "Everyday Use" reliability, these tapes were designed for recording television series, movies, and home videos with a clear signal-to-noise ratio and a lifetime warranty. Finding a bulk quantity of these classic American-made tapes in factory-sealed condition is increasingly rare for media collectors and analog enthusiasts.
49 Factory-sealed videocassettes (T-120 format)
Standard Grade for everyday recording needs
Made in the USA by 3M Consumer Video and Audio Products
Recording Time: 2 hours (SP), 4 hours (LP), 6 hours (EP/SLP)
Condition:
All 49 tapes are in New In Packaging (NIP) condition, remaining factory sealed in their original clear plastic wrap. The protective cardboard sleeves are well-preserved with sharp corners and vibrant graphics, showing only negligible signs of shelf wear from long-term storage. All units are unused and pristine.
